question: At which of the following Harappan sites has a dockyard been found suggesting the existence of trade?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lothal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lothal**

 
 
• **The dockyard at Indus valley civilization was found in Lothal.**
 
• Lothal was one of the southernmost destinations of the antiquated Indus Valley civilisation,located in the Bhāl district of the advanced territory of Gujarāt.
 
• Development of the city is accepted to have started around** 2200 BCE.**
 
• The uncovered site of Lothal is the main port-town of the **Indus Valley **Civilisation.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Archeologists accept the main flowing dockyard on the planet was inherent Lothal.
 
• Daimabad
 
 
• **Daimabad** is a neglected town and an archeological site from the Indus Valley Civilization.
 
 
 
• Alamgirpu
 
 
• **Alamgirpur** is an archeological site of the Indus Valley progress that flourished along Yamuna Waterway (3300-1300 BC) from the Harappan-Bara period.
 
 
 
• Manda
 
 
• **Manda** is arranged on the right bank of Chenab Waterway in the lower regions of Pir Panjal range, 28 km northwest of Jammu.
